records.title: 3D remake: skill effects status
records.description: The 3D remakes run the 2D game's own code, so every skill, spell and augmentation works there. Particles, projectiles, flashes, blasts and the swing trail are true 3D; everything else the 2D game paints for skills (lightning, frost, slam waves, chains, rings, elite effects) is still painted in 2D and laid over the 3D view as a smoothed, bloomed layer. Rebuilding skill effects one by one as true 3D is still on the to-do list, in both the overhead 3D game and The World.
records.notes: Not a 2D-game asset: lives in diablo-clone/game3d (fx.js: syncOverlayFx, syncGroundFx, heroBlade) and diablo-clone/world3d.
